schema.description: The seven key principles, each with its stated legal basis: Principle 1: Price indication should be clear and transparent (legal basis: Articles 6 (1) (d) and 7 of the UCPD, and Article 6 (1) (e) of the CRD). Principle 2: Practices obscuring the cost of in-game digital content and services should be avoided (legal basis: Articles 6 (1) (d) and 7 of the UCPD, and Article 6 (1) (e) of the CRD). Principle 3: Practices that force consumers to purchase unwanted in-game virtual currency should be avoided (legal basis: Articles 5, 8 and 9 of the UCPD). Principle 4: Consumers should be provided with clear and comprehensible pre-contractual information (legal basis: Article 6 of the CRD). Principle 5: Consumers’ right of withdrawal should be respected (legal basis: Articles 9 to 16 of the CRD). Principle 6: Contractual terms should be fair and written in plain and clear language (legal basis: Article 3 (1) and (3) of the UCTD). Principle 7: Game design and gameplay should be respectful of different consumer vulnerabilities (legal basis: Articles 5-8 and Point 28 of Annex I of the UCPD).
schema.title: CPC Network key principles on in-game virtual currencies (March 2025)
